answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through coastal telemetry attestation. Each node registers by streaming real-time physical entropy, pairing hydrophone data from a marine reef with optical tracking of a wild falcon through a jade filter. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of deploying scarce, geographically separated physical sensor rigs per identity. However, storms and wildlife migration cause signal dropouts, leading to false rejections of valid agents.
